description: This file defines the FilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project, which encapsulates filter parameters such as sort order, sort field, limit, and offset for search or listing operations. It includes methods for setting and retrieving these parameters, with validation for the sort order.

classes.name: FilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates filtering parameters for search or listing operations, including sort order, sort field, limit, and offset.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sort order, either ascending or descending.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order; throws SearchParamException if the value is invalid.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the current sort field, which can be null.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the sort field; can be null.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the current limit for number of items.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit for number of items.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset for pagination.
